name: Joan Lamburn
bio: A writer of children's stories, Louis Wilkinson's fourth and last wife, married after his divorce from Diana Bryn. She died in 1956, ten years before he did.
bio_note: The fourth marriage is footnoted on the article to Wilkinson's Times obituary. Eliot letter of 9 February 1929; Ann Reid to Wilkinson's own Seven Friends (1953) dedication and to Friedman (2002), with her 1932 death to Elwin (1946), p. 207; Diana Bryn to Who Was Who; Joan Lamburn to his Times obituary.
